{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Wood Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Wood Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Wood Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Wood Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |pronunciation= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |cost= |value= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= {{Rupee|BotW|2}} |TotK= {{Rupee|TotK|2}} |AoC= {{Rupee|AoC|2}} |AoI= {{Rupee|AoI|3}} }} |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= Starting [[Campfire]]s, Remaking the [[Great Eagle Bow]] }} |strength= {{Infobox Game Blocks |TotK= 1 {{Small|([[Fuse]] Attack Power)}} }} |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Wood|Wood|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI}} is a recurring [[Item]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK, AoI}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== In {{BotW}}, Wood can be obtained from [[Woodcutting]] [[Tree]]s throughout [[Hyrule]] or found at various settlements like [[Hateno Village]] or [[Stable]]s. They can be chopped using any bladed [[Weapon]] or knocked down with [[Remote Bomb]]s. Once a Tree is felled, [[Link]] can strike or blow up the fallen [[Log]] to create a bundle of Wood. Wood can be used to light [[Campfire]]s, along with a flammable [[Weapon]] or a piece of [[Flint]] and a metallic Weapon. In addition, Wood is used during the "[[Hylian Homeowner]]" [[Side Quest]] to buy [[Link's House]], as well as during the "[[From the Ground Up]]" Side Quest to construct [[House]]s for [[Tarrey Town]]. To remake the [[Great Eagle Bow]], Link must bring [[Harth]] a [[Swallow Bow]], a [[Diamond]], and five bundles of Wood. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Wood can be found by chopping down [[Tree]]s. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} Wood is a type of [[Material]] that can be obtained by [[Woodcutting]] [[Tree]]s during [[Challenge]]s and [[Scenario]]s.
